syllabus_topics: Component assembly: Model visualization; Interference detection.
General aspects: Standards; Lettering; Formats, border, folding, title block; Lines and strokes; Scales.
Projections: Types of Projections; Choice of Views. Types of perspectives
Cuts and Sections: Representation; Hatching; Types of cut; Conventional representations; Sections.
Dimensioning: Dimensioning elements; Choice of dimensions; Dimensioning of assemblies.
Representation of Standardized Components: Threads; Washers, Keys; Springs; Gears; Bearings; Transmissions.
Production Drawings: Descriptive memory; Assembly drawing, piece by piece; Drawing revision.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of the final project (AP)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as: Final Grade = OT 7.5% + EIP 12.5% + PF 70% + AP 10%. A minimum grade of 10 values is required for the final project (PF). The evaluation of the Final Project considers: Modeling 40%, Technical Drawings 40%, descriptive memory and overall appreciation 20%.
